grade-title.title: Stock grader
grade-title.body: Six dimensions graded against every US stock over $2B: momentum, value, quality, growth, earnings and flows. The composite weights growth, quality and momentum most. Evidence, not advice.

mode-many.title: Several tickers
mode-many.body: Paste up to 25 tickers, separated by commas, spaces or new lines. You get one table: the composite and the six letters for each name, best composite first. Click a ticker for its full card.

drivers-h.title: What drives each grade
drivers-h.body: Every input behind a dimension: its value, its percentile against the $2B+ universe where the formula reads one, the 0 to 100 score it feeds in, and its weight inside the dimension.

peers-h.title: Against its peers
peers-h.body: The stock next to the medians of its GICS sub-industry, industry group and sector, names over $2B, and its rank on the leaderboard composite inside each group.

halal.title: The halal screen
halal.body: Five tests from AAOIFI Shariah Standard 21, on quarterly filings and the month-end market cap. The same numbers drive the halal filter in backtests. It approximates the standard; it is not a fatwa or a ruling.

method.title: What the screen cannot see
method.body: Business is judged by today's industry class, not revenue share, so a hotel with bars can pass. Many companies do not report interest income, and that test then shows as not run, never as passed.
